svg.aria-label: How your vault is sealed: master password (never stored), Argon2id (100 MiB, 3 passes, 32-byte salt), PBKDF2-SHA3-256 (110,000 iterations), a 256-bit key held in memory only while the vault is open, AES-256-GCM on every field with a fresh nonce, saved to Bunker.mmf on your disk.
svg.title: How your vault is sealed
svg.text: No server, no account, no sync. Forget the master password and nobody can open the vault, including us.
